When price breaks through the moving average, the move has already occurred in the market. Therefore, expecting technical indicators to buy at the absolute low and sell at the absolute high is mathematically and logically unrealistic.

strings.均線數值是過去 N 天收盤價的算術平均。透過觀察 N 天前的歷史價格（即扣抵位置: The moving average value is the arithmetic mean of the closing prices of the past N days. By observing the historical price N days ago (i.e., the offset position), traders can anticipate: as long as today's closing price is higher than the offset price from N days ago, that moving average will necessarily move upward tomorrow; conversely it will move downward. The offset value helps traders eliminate lag and anticipate the time point at which the moving average is about to turn.

strings.均線數值是過去 N 天收盤價的算術平均。透過觀察 N 天前的歷史價格（即扣抵位置: 移動平均値は、過去N日間の終値の算術平均です。N日前の歴史価格（すなわちオフセット位置）を観察することで、トレーダーは事前に予測できます。今日の終値がN日前のオフセット価格を上回っている場合、明日その移動平均は必ず上向きに向かいます。逆に下向きになります。オフセット値はトレーダーの遅延を解消し、移動平均が転換する時点を前もって洞察するのに役立ちます。
